To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“the reliability of the bonding system in combination with the used BOM, the technology node, and the product is the main limitation factor for the overall package reliability”.
“the reliability of IC package is strongly influenced by the BOM and the wafer technology”.
the reliability of a product is a function of the quality of the components, the quality of the assembly process, and the quality of the product design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a robustness validation of the qualification activities for integrated circuits used in the automotive sector.

the validation of the reliability of the integrated circuits for automotive applications, in particular with the validation of robustness and the determination of the reliability of different types of packages and the influence of different types of BOM.
robustness validation and reliability qualification activities of integrated circuit (IC) for automotive industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
robustness validation is an essential and necessary activity to be performed during qualification of integrated circuits.
the qualification activities of integrated circuit for automotive industry have to be based on the robustness validation of devices and packages.
the robustness validation activities are very useful and should be considered as mandatory for all products, even though they may not have a high failure rate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the package reliability is the most critical factor and it is necessary to use a more robust package for automotive industry.
the robustness validation is a very powerful tool in order to improve the robustness of the products and thus the reliability.

the robustness validation activities are a key part of the qualification process for automotive industry and the main focus of these activities is to ensure that the device is capable of performing in the application environment for which it is qualified.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the robustness validation is a must for all ICs and it is not only an option for the automotive industry.
robustness validation is not only the responsibility of the IC manufacturer, but it should be also considered in the qualification activities of the IC user.
the reliability of a product can be significantly improved by a combination of different technologies and BOM.
